title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 11: David anointed king at Hebron, the taking of Zion and the deeds of his mighty men.

questions.text: Where did all Israel gather themselves to David at the start of the chapter?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 11:1 says all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron.

questions.text: What had Yahweh said David would be to his people Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh had told David that he would be shepherd of his people Israel and prince over his people Israel.

questions.text: By what other name is Jerusalem called in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, also called Jebus, where the Jebusites lived.

questions.text: Who went up first against the Jebusites and was made chief?
questions.explanation: David promised that whoever struck the Jebusites first would be chief and captain, and Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first and was made chief.

questions.text: Against how many men did Jashobeam lift up his spear, killing them at one time?
questions.explanation: Jashobeam, the chief of the thirty, lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.

questions.text: At Pasdammim, what was the plot of ground full of where Eleazar and the others stood and fought?
questions.explanation: At Pasdammim the Philistines gathered where there was a plot of ground full of barley, and they stood in the middle of the plot and defended it.

questions.text: What did David do with the water the three men brought him from the well of Bethlehem?
questions.explanation: David would not drink any of it but poured it out to Yahweh, because the men had risked their lives to bring it.

answers.text: He shared it with the three men
He poured it out to Yahweh

questions.text: What did Benaiah go down to the tall Egyptian with?
questions.explanation: Benaiah went down to the Egyptian with a staff, plucked the spear out of his hand and killed him with his own spear.

questions.text: What did David set Benaiah the son of Jehoiada over?
questions.explanation: Benaiah was more honorable than the thirty, but did not attain to the three, and David set him over his guard.

questions.text: Which of these men is named in the list of David's mighty men?
questions.explanation: Verse 41 lists Uriah the Hittite among the mighty men of the armies.
